phase: Bounded current-first-party research and preflight only
scopeBoundary: Research/disposition only. No seat transcription, Human Pass, venue-source creation, production integration, generated catalog/runtime, fingerprint, application code, validator, or existing production data was touched. GMO, RaiBoC, 日野市民会館大ホール, 宝生能楽堂, and every pre-existing blocked/HARD-CASE record were out of scope.
policyBasis: ADOPT requires a current issuer-defined representative configuration and direct lossless ownership of every (area,row,seat). No capacity fitting, row propagation, geometry/symmetry completion, alternate-layout mixing, or third-party completion is permitted. An implementation remains separately gated by fresh independent Human Passes 1/2, expanded-set bidirectional equality, issuer subtotal reconciliation, an independent structural checksum, and explicit accessibility/movability treatment.

livePoolReconstruction.rankingMethod: All live candidates were re-ranked from current inventory rather than carried over. Dedicated ticketed theatres/theaters/theatres, 演芸場, 能楽堂, 音楽堂, concert halls, auditoria and proper-noun specialist halls ranked before civic 大・中・小・主・メインホール. Within a tier, current assigned-seat programming, a current issuer chart, an issuer-separated standard configuration, and issuer/sibling precedent raised priority. Capacity unknown and missing stored URLs were neutral; studios, rehearsal/training/meeting spaces, live houses, free seating, and user-arranged movable chairs were deprioritised.
